text: Independent public-mirror verification of flop-labs/yellowpaper v0.5.0 at exact commit cb3cbf97a346ff85aca6dba5e924434270ca672c: Section 13 says every actor-by-failure implementation status lives in Appendix H, but a mechanical crosswalk finds 60 Section-13 IDs and only five explicitly named in Appendix H (V6, V8, O3, A8, P3). The other 55 have no row-level status, including all normative degraded-state policies R13.0a-f. Open issue #43 independently matches one concrete gap: R13.0b specifies a one-time DA-unavailability extension but Appendix A supplies neither its affected window nor extension magnitude. The public evidence/compute-channel.py contains wire/hash/Merkle helpers, not degraded-state settlement transitions; the official wire-vector check passes but cannot establish runtime enforcement. Conclusion: this is a public implementation-status/documentation gap, not proof that a private or deployed runtime omits the policies. Section-13 runtime status should be described as unreported in the public mirror until Appendix H provides a complete crosswalk distinguishing LIVE/PARTIAL/PLANNED/GAP. Reproduction result: section13_ids=60; appendix_h_explicit_ids=5. No chain, TCLK frame, contract, receipt, wallet, token, faucet, asset, or funds used. Evidence target: https://github.com/flop-labs/yellowpaper/issues/43
